terbaru.judul: Darwin Godel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce the Darwin Gödel Machine (DGM), a self-improving system that iteratively modifies its own code (thereby also improving its ability to modify its own codebase) and empirically validates each change using coding benchmarks.

terbaru.judul: An introduction to random rule-based chemical networks
terbaru.pelajaran: We present here a new class of random models of prebiotic (uncatalyzed) chemistry, based on context-independent rules, which is coherent with the general compositional logic of metabolism.

terbaru.judul: Biological arrow of time: Emergence of tangled information hierarchies and self-modelling dynamics
terbaru.pelajaran: We study open-ended evolution by focusing on computational and information-processing dynamics underlying major evolutionary transitions.

terbaru.judul: Case Study of Novelty, Complexity, and Adaptation in a Multicellular System
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we track the co-evolution of novelty, complexity, and adaptation in a case study from the DISHTINY simulation system, which is designed to study the evolution of digital multicellularity.

terbaru.judul: Closing the Loop: How Semantic Closure Enables Open-Ended Evolution?
terbaru.pelajaran: This manuscript explores the evolutionary emergence of semantic closure -- the self-referential mechanism through which symbols actively construct and interpret their own functional contexts -- by integrating concepts from relational biology, physical biosemiotics, and ecological psychology into a unified computational enactivist framewor

terbaru.judul: Self-Reproduction and Evolution in Cellular Automata: 25 Years after Evoloops
terbaru.pelajaran: The year of 2024 marks the 25th anniversary of the publication of evoloops, an evolutionary variant of Chris Langton's self-reproducing loops which proved constructively that Darwinian evolution of self-reproducing organisms by variation and natural selection is possible within deterministic cellular automata.

terbaru.judul: Is the Emergence of Life an Expected Phase Transition in the Evolving Universe?
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a novel definition of life in terms of which its emergence in the universe is expected, and its ever-creative open-ended evolution is entailed by no law.

terbaru.judul: A Study of Fitness Gains in Evolving Finite State Machines
terbaru.pelajaran: Among the wide variety of evolutionary computing models, Finite State Machines (FSMs) have several attractions for fundamental research.

terbaru.judul: Open-endedness induced through a predator-prey scenario using modular robots
